name: hair-clip-project
description: Parametric monolithic PETG hair clip with a true honeycomb lattice

scripts.test: npm run build && python3 validate_stl.py output/masculine-honeycomb-hair-clip-r4.stl --output validation/mesh-audit-clip-r4.json && python3 validate_stl.py output/hair-clip-latch-coupon-r4.stl --output validation/mesh-audit-coupon-r4.json && python3 validate_3mf.py output/masculine-honeycomb-hair-clip-r4.3mf --output validation/3mf-audit-r4.json && python3 validate_r4_features.py --metrics output/generation-metrics.json --mesh-audit validation/mesh-audit-clip-r4.json --output validation/revision4-feature-audit.json
